stem: Which tool is an IDE designed primarily for working in the R language?
explanation: RStudio is an IDE built around R, with a console, script editor, plots pane and environment viewer. Spyder is an IDE aimed at Python, Azure Data Studio was a SQL Server tool that Microsoft retired in February 2026, and VS Code is a general-purpose editor that supports R only through extensions.

stem: Which Python library provides the DataFrame, a labeled table structure used to load, filter and reshape tabular data?
explanation: pandas is the Python library that provides the DataFrame. The tidyverse is a set of R packages, Anaconda is a distribution that bundles Python and packages, and DBeaver is a database client.

stem: An analyst wants to share one file that combines runnable code, the charts it produces and written commentary, so colleagues can follow the analysis step by step. Which tool fits best?
explanation: A notebook interleaves code cells, their output and narrative text in one shareable document. A text editor shows code but no rendered output, a database query client runs queries but does not mix in narrative, and a spreadsheet holds data and charts but not runnable analysis code.

stem: Larkspur Analytics wants every new analyst laptop to get Python, R and hundreds of data science packages with one installer, plus isolated environments per project. What should the team install?
explanation: Anaconda is a distribution that bundles Python, R support and many packages, and its conda manager creates isolated environments. pandas is only one library, Scala is a programming language, and Tableau Desktop is visualization software.

stem: Which tool is the graphical client for browsing and querying MongoDB document collections?
explanation: MongoDB Compass lets users explore documents, build queries and view schema in a graphical interface. Toad targets relational databases such as Oracle, SSMS is for SQL Server, and RStudio is an IDE for R.

stem: Harbor Point Insurance already licenses Microsoft 365 and wants interactive dashboards that staff can open in Teams and SharePoint. Which tool is the most natural fit?
explanation: Power BI is Microsoft's business intelligence platform and integrates directly with Microsoft 365, Teams and SharePoint. Looker is Google Cloud's BI platform and does not integrate as closely with Teams and SharePoint, SAS is an analytics language and suite, and MySQL Workbench is a database design and query tool.

stem: An analyst queries PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle databases each week and wants one free, cross-platform client for all three. Which tool fits best?
explanation: DBeaver is a universal database client that connects to many engines through drivers, and its community edition is free. SQL Server Management Studio targets SQL Server on Windows, MySQL Workbench targets MySQL, and MongoDB Compass is for MongoDB.

stem: Which programming language runs on the Java Virtual Machine and is the language in which Apache Spark was originally written?
explanation: Scala compiles to Java bytecode and is Spark's native language. R and Python can drive Spark through interfaces but are not its implementation language, and SAS is a separate commercial analytics language.

stem: A pharmaceutical company wants a commercially licensed statistical language with vendor support contracts and a long record in regulated clinical reporting. Which choice fits best?
explanation: SAS is proprietary software sold with vendor support and has long been used for clinical trial reporting. R and Python are open source and rely on community or third-party support, and Scala is a general-purpose language aimed at distributed processing.

stem: Which collection of R packages includes dplyr for data manipulation and ggplot2 for charts?
explanation: The tidyverse is a set of R packages, including dplyr and ggplot2, that share a common design. pandas is a Python library, Anaconda is a Python and R distribution, and Looker is a business intelligence platform.

stem: An analyst needs to fix a typo in a small configuration file on a shared server and does not need to run or debug anything. Which tool is the lightest suitable choice?
explanation: A plain text editor opens and saves plain files with no project setup, which is all this task needs. RStudio adds a full IDE for R, a notebook is for running code with output, and DBeaver is a database client.

stem: Fennel Retail keeps its warehouse in Google BigQuery and wants metrics defined once in a version-controlled modeling layer that every dashboard reuses. Which platform is built around that approach?
explanation: Looker, part of Google Cloud, centers on a code-based semantic model, LookML, kept in Git and queried live against the warehouse. Tableau and Power BI can connect to BigQuery but define most logic in each workbook or dataset, and SAS is an analytics suite rather than a dashboard platform.

stem: A team wants one free, general-purpose code editor that supports Python, SQL scripts, notebooks and Git through installable extensions. Which tool fits best?
explanation: VS Code is a free, language-neutral editor whose extensions add Python, SQL, notebook and Git support. RStudio is centered on R, Toad is a commercial database tool, and MongoDB Compass is a MongoDB client.

stem: A database team that mainly runs Oracle wants a commercial desktop tool for query tuning, schema comparison and code review. Which tool is most closely associated with that work?
explanation: Toad is a commercial database tool long used with Oracle for tuning, schema comparison and code analysis. MongoDB Compass is for MongoDB, Looker is a business intelligence platform, and Azure Data Studio was a SQL Server and Azure tool that Microsoft retired in February 2026.

stem: Analysts on macOS and Linux need a currently supported Microsoft tool to query SQL Server and keep their queries in notebooks. Which tool meets both needs?

options.text: VS Code with the SQL Server extension

explanation: VS Code with Microsoft's SQL Server (mssql) extension runs on macOS and Linux and supports SQL notebooks, and it is Microsoft's recommended replacement for Azure Data Studio. Azure Data Studio offered the same features but was retired on 28 February 2026, SSMS runs only on Windows, and MySQL Workbench targets MySQL rather than SQL Server.

stem: Which tool is Oracle's official graphical application for data modeling, SQL development and server administration of its open-source relational database?
explanation: MySQL Workbench is the official tool for Oracle's open-source MySQL database, covering data modeling, SQL development and server administration. SSMS is for SQL Server, MongoDB Compass is for MongoDB, and Tableau is visualization software.

stem: A marketing analyst who does not write code wants to build charts by dragging fields onto shelves in a desktop app, then publish them to a shared server. Which tool fits best?
explanation: Tableau Desktop builds visuals by dragging fields onto rows, columns and marks, and workbooks publish to Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud. SAS and pandas require code, and RStudio is an IDE for writing R.

stem: Which TWO of the following are programming languages commonly used for data analysis?
explanation: Python and R are programming languages with large data analysis ecosystems. Tableau is visualization software, DBeaver is a database client, and Anaconda is a distribution that packages languages and libraries.

stem: A company is shortlisting business intelligence platforms for self-service dashboards. Which TWO belong on the list?
explanation: Tableau and Qlik Sense are business intelligence platforms for building and sharing self-service dashboards. Scala is a programming language, Toad is a database tool, and pandas is a Python library.

stem: A database administrator needs tools built specifically to query and manage SQL Server instances. Which TWO are designed for this?

options.text: VS Code with the SQL Server extension

explanation: SSMS and VS Code with Microsoft's SQL Server (mssql) extension are built for connecting to, querying and managing SQL Server; the extension replaces the retired Azure Data Studio. MongoDB Compass is for MongoDB, MySQL Workbench is for MySQL, and Looker is a business intelligence platform.

stem: Which TWO of the following are libraries or package collections that extend a language?
explanation: pandas is a Python library and the tidyverse is a collection of R packages; both extend a language. SAS is a language and software suite, VS Code is an editor, Looker is a business intelligence platform, and Azure Data Studio is a database tool that Microsoft retired in February 2026.

stem: Which TWO features set a notebook such as Jupyter apart from running a plain script file?

options.text: Code is split into cells that can run one at a time
The whole file is compiled into one program before it runs
Charts and tables appear directly below the code that made them
Each run starts a fresh interpreter with no saved variables
Imported libraries stay loaded only for the line that uses them

explanation: Notebooks run code cell by cell and show each cell's output inline, which suits exploration. A whole-file compile and a fresh interpreter on every run describe scripts, not notebooks, and libraries stay loaded for the session in both.

stem: Match each tool to the category it belongs to.
explanation: VS Code is where code is written and run, Power BI builds dashboards, the tidyverse adds functions to R, Scala is a language, and DBeaver connects to and queries databases.

partExplanations.p1: VS Code is a general-purpose code editor and IDE.
partExplanations.p2: Power BI is Microsoft's business intelligence platform.
partExplanations.p3: The tidyverse is a collection of R packages.
partExplanations.p4: Scala is a programming language that runs on the Java Virtual Machine.

stem: Sort each item into the category that best describes it.
explanation: SAS and Python are languages for writing analysis code. Looker and Tableau build dashboards. Toad and MySQL Workbench connect to databases to query and manage them.

partExplanations.sas: SAS is a statistical programming language and suite.
partExplanations.python: Python is a general-purpose language widely used for analysis.
partExplanations.looker: Looker is Google Cloud's business intelligence platform.
partExplanations.tableau: Tableau is drag-and-drop visualization and dashboard software.
partExplanations.toad: Toad is a commercial database development and administration tool.
partExplanations.workbench: MySQL Workbench models, queries and administers MySQL databases.

stem: An analyst pulls data from a SQL Server database, cleans it in Python, and publishes a dashboard. Label the tool used at each stage.
explanation: SSMS queries SQL Server, pandas cleans data in Python, and Power BI publishes dashboards. MongoDB Compass is for MongoDB and the tidyverse is for R, so neither fits this pipeline.

partExplanations.z-query: SSMS is Microsoft's query and management tool for SQL Server; MongoDB Compass only connects to MongoDB.
partExplanations.z-clean: pandas is the Python library for cleaning tables; the tidyverse runs in R, not Python.
partExplanations.z-report: Power BI builds and shares dashboards; MongoDB Compass and the tidyverse do not publish dashboards.

stem: An analyst's Python script fails because a library is missing. Review the terminal output, then complete each step.

steps.label: Type the command that switches to the churn-study environment
Type a conda command that installs the missing library into the active environment
Choose the best way to keep this fix reproducible for teammates

options.text: Export the environment to a file and commit it with the project
Install every library into the base environment instead
Email teammates a copy of the analyst's anaconda3 folder
Add a comment listing the library at the top of the script

explanation: The error shows pandas is missing from the active base environment. Activating churn-study and installing pandas there fixes it, and exporting the environment file lets teammates rebuild the same setup.

partExplanations.activate: conda activate churn-study makes that environment the active one.
partExplanations.install: conda install pandas adds the library to the active environment.
partExplanations.next: An exported environment file (conda env export) records exact packages so others can recreate it; installing into base or copying folders is fragile, and a comment does not install anything.
